$comment: Ingest contract for automated product research. It exists so the automation has somewhere honest to write when - and only when - it has a permitted source. No instance of this schema is populated in this repository, because no authorised data source is connected. Absence is the correct state, not a missing file.
title: research_snapshot

captured_at_utc.description: When the data was actually retrieved. Publishes a visible 'data as of' stamp; a snapshot older than ttl_hours must be hidden, not labelled.

source_system.description: Only these four may ever appear. A scraped page is not a source system and the validator rejects anything else.

source_endpoint.description: Exact operation or report path, e.g. 'Items' or 'Reports > Transactions'. Needed so a row can be re-checked a month later.

eligibility_basis.description: The credential state at capture time. If false, no item may carry a price, availability, rating or review field, and the build refuses to render one.

ttl_hours.description: Maximum staleness tolerated before a field is suppressed rather than displayed with a date. The 24-hour ceiling is set by Amazon's caching rule as described in the Program Policies; the policy wording itself remains an unresolved register row (S02).

retention_note.description: Where the raw response was stored and for how long, so a published figure can be traced to bytes.

asin.description: Ten characters. A 9-character token is not an ASIN and will not validate - the failure that this project's own five links hit.

title_observed.description: Verbatim listing title. Reproduced as an observation; never rewritten into a claim.

commission_basis_points.description: Record the rate Amazon reported, per category, with its date. Never a rate looked up on a third-party table.

specifications.description: Key/value as returned by the API. Free text describing a product is not a specification.

derived_metrics_allowed.description: Which computed figures may be published from this snapshot. Empty by default.

const: no search-volume or trend claim may cite this snapshot
no revenue forecast may be built from it
no superiority claim ('best', 'top-rated') may be derived from a rating or review count alone

validation_rules: An item with asin_provenance 'observed_redirect' may be used for identification and navigation only: no price, no rating, no spec block renders on a product page until the owner or the API confirms the ASIN.
captured_at_utc + ttl_hours earlier than build time means every volatile field is suppressed at render, and the page says 'not current' rather than showing the stale value.
Any item where every volatile field is null is a legal snapshot - this is exactly the state the shipped register is in today.
